title: things I asked AI this week
caption:
my chat history, lightly redacted.

"explain this code" — I wrote it. yesterday.
"is this good? be honest. no, be nice."
and at 2am, after a long session: "are you mad at me."

what's the most unhinged thing you've asked an AI?
